result.summary: The screen is broadly usable, but several rendering problems stand out: a stuck image loading spinner on the featured 'Popular right now' card, clipped/truncated text in the horizontal carousel, a partially rendered filter chip with no visible label, and inconsistent favorite-button styling between cards.

issues.description: The hero image for 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' in 'Popular right now' still shows a loading spinner overlaying a partially loaded/blurred image, suggesting the image never finished loading or the spinner isn't dismissed on load.
issues.suggestion: Hide the spinner on the image load/error event and show a static placeholder or fallback thumbnail if loading fails; add a timeout so spinners don't persist indefinitely.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' has its title clipped mid-word ('Trattoria Piccol') at the screen edge with no ellipsis, and the card itself is cut off flush against the viewport, making it unclear the row is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text truncation with ellipsis to card titles and add trailing padding/peek so the next card is visibly partially shown, signalling horizontal scroll.

issues.description: The category filter row ends with an unlabeled chip fragment clipped at the right edge, appearing as an empty grey pill rather than a readable category.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal scroll padding and ensure chips are laid out so a partially visible chip still shows readable text, or add a fade/gradient edge indicator.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the first card uses a white circular background with a dark outline heart while the second uses a dark/translucent circle with a white heart.
issues.suggestion: Standardise the favorite button background and icon colour across all restaurant cards, ideally using a consistent scrim for legibility on any image.

issues.description: The second 'Popular right now' card (-20% promo) is cut off by the bottom navigation bar with no visible restaurant name, and there is no bottom spacing so content appears to sit under the nav.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom content inset/padding equal to the nav bar height so the last card can fully scroll into view above the tab bar.

issues.description: Secondary text such as '€0.90 delivery' and the '25–35 min • €0 delivery • Ramen' metadata line uses light grey on white, likely below the 4.5:1 contrast threshold.
issues.suggestion: Darken the secondary text colour to meet WCAG AA contrast for body text.
